stemMd: A writer wants to introduce an essay about a community project that transforms damaged umbrellas into shopping bags. Which opening most clearly establishes that subject?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Umbrellas come in many colors and sizes.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Many people enjoy a rainy afternoon.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Shopping is a common activity around the world.

options.label: D
options.textMd: At the repair center, broken umbrellas begin a second life as reusable bags.

explanationMd: An effective opening identifies the central activity. The umbrellas' second life as bags establishes both the discarded material and the community project's outcome.

distractorRationale.a: A broad observation about umbrellas does not establish the transformation project.
distractorRationale.c: This generalization does not identify the project or its materials.
distractorRationale.b: Enjoyment of rain does not introduce the reuse activity.
